name: unity
description: Unity for coding agents: batch-mode compile, method runs and tests at blind, agent or human profile, readiness-checked screenshots, terrain from data, loading gates and posed spawns. Kits are source copied into the project.

interface.shortDescription: Compile, test, build terrain and capture Unity projects unattended
interface.longDescription: Install small source kits into a Unity project: a batch-mode driver that reports compile errors and test results at a chosen profile (no graphics, cheap graphics, full quality), a capture script that waits until the scene is ready, a terrain builder that turns a layout written as data into a Terrain, and runtime code that keeps a loading cover up until the world is ready and never shows a spawned character in bind pose. Skills cover the batch loop, readiness rules and splitting work across agents in separate environments. Every install is planned first and never overwrites a file you changed.
defaultPrompt: Use $unity-batch-loop to check that this project compiles and its tests pass.
Use $unity-readiness to make this level load behind a cover until it is ready, and check the first frames.
Use $unity-parallel to split this work across subagents in separate environments and merge it.
